title_lines: 英国英国改革党领袖奈

subtitles.en: I thought about it hard and I've decided today, today, I will resign as a member of Parliament for Clackton on C, thereby forcing a by-election, which should happen, I hope, in short order.
subtitles.zh: 我深思熟虑后决定，今天辞去克拉顿选区议员职务，从而触发补选，希望尽快举行。
en_highlights: resign as a member of Parliament

subtitles.en: Now, I've decided that the people of Clackton should be the judges of my actions.
subtitles.zh: 我决定让克拉顿人民来评判我的行为。

subtitles.en: This will be a people versus the establishment by-election. It's a chance to stick to fingers up
subtitles.zh: 这将是一场人民对阵建制派的补选，是向整个建制派竖中指的机会。

subtitles.en: to the entire establishment to frankly tell them where to go. And that is why I will be putting my name
subtitles.zh: 直白地告诉他们该去哪。因此我将报名参选这场补选。

subtitles.en: forward to stand in this by-election. I will fight to win. I will fight to continue the political revolution that reform has started. And I would say this to you, the voters of Clackton. If I win,
subtitles.zh: 我会为胜利而战，继续改革党开启的政治革命。对克拉顿选民说：如果我赢，你们就赢。

subtitles.en: you win. Because if I lose, they win. And we will never, with the two old parties, get the type of fundamental change that we need to fix, broken, Britain.
subtitles.zh: 如果我输，他们就赢。两大旧党永远不会带来修复破碎英国所需的根本变革。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
